tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skyes bu dbang gi mdog can la bstod pa 'jigs rung gshin rje'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mi bzad rgyal ba'i drag po'i 'phrin las kun/ /gcig bsdus ma rungs tshar gcod gnod sbyin dbang / /yam shud dmar po dam nyams zhing bcu'i gshed/ /rnal 'byor dgra lha chen por bstod par bgyi/ /gang sku bye ru'i lhun po rdul bral la/ /dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar ba'i gzi mdangs 'phro/ /bdud sde ma lus tsitta tshal par 'gas/ /sgeg dang dpa' ba'i gzugs khyod bstod par bgyi/ /zhal dkyil gshin rje khros 'dra mche ba gtsigs/ /ljags bskyod drag po'i spyan gsum dgra la gzir/ /shangs nas 'thor rlung nag pos stong gsum 'gengs/ /log 'dren bdud kyi gshed khyod bstod par bgyi/ /rab dmar snyan shal rus pa'i rna chas brgyan/ /dbu skyes ltag bcings zangs rmog thod du 'gyings/ /thod skam dbu brgyan thod rlon do shal can/ /drag gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs khyod bstod par bgyi/ /sku la zangs kyi beg rtse dmar po dang / /ra skyes g.yang bzhi khrag 'dzag lding stabs gyon/ /sag ti'i lh+wam 'bog zhabs zung mdzes par brgyan/ /mi zad 'jigs pa'i brgyan 'chang bstod par bgyi/ /phyag g.yas zangs ral 'bar ba nam mkhar 'phyar/ /phyag g.yon dgra bgegs glo snying thugs kar 'dzin/ /ru mtshon byer dbyug mda' gzhu mchan du thogs/ /dam ldan bstan srung dbang por bstod par bgyi/ /khro 'khrugs rngams pa'i zhabs zung brkyang bskum gyis/ /rta dmar dam nyams dbugs bral gdan steng du/ /'gying zhing brdzis pa'i tshul gyis rnam par bzhugs/ /skyes bu dbang gi mdog can bstod par bgyi/ /skyes bu khyod kyi sta zur g.yon phyogs su/ /rab gtum mi bzod dred mo 'gying ba'i khrir/ /'jigs gzugs srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ /srin mo khros pa'i gzugs can bstod par bgyi/ /zhal dkyil bse yi rang bzhin dmar zhing snum/

/rno dkar dung gi mche gtsigs smin ma g.yu/ /ljags bskyod spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug /srid pa'i ma mo chen mor bstod par bgyi/ /me ral mchong dang mu men rgyan gyis mdzes/ /thod skam dbu rgyan mgo rlon do shal can/ /dar nag gos kyi lhab lhub sku la gsol/ /srin mo gdong dmar ma khyod bstod par bgyi/ /g.yang bzhi khrag 'dzag lding stabs gyon zhing 'jigs/ /rus pa'i rgyan cha sbrul nag chun pos dkris/ /ba spu'i khung nas nad kyi 'tshub ma ldang / /srid gsum dal yams bdag mor bstod par bgyi/ /phyag g.yas zangs kyi ral gris dgra srog gcod/ /phyag g.yon lcags kyi phur bus bgegs dpung 'joms/ /rab khros brkyang bskum zhabs kyis gar stabs g.yo/ /padma gar gyi dbang phyug bstod par bgyi/ /yam shud dmar po'i g.yas kyi sta zur du/ /rgyags shing dregs pa'i ce spyang sngon po'i steng / /btsan mchog srog bdag dmar po sde brgyad gtso/ /bstan dgra sdig can bshan par bstod par bgyi/ /sku mdog bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i gzi/ /khro gnyer glog stong 'khyug cing aṃ gtsigs bsdams/ /'jigs pa'i sdang mig phyogs bcu kun tu g.yo/ /dgra snying phye mar 'gems khyod bstod par bgyi/ /dbu la bse rmog me 'od 'bar ba gsol/ /sku la nyi gzhon mdangs ldan bse khrab bsnams/ /phyag g.yas mdung dmar g.yon pas btsan zhags 'dzin/ /ma rungs thal bar rlog khyod bstod par bgyi/ /gtso 'khor gsum gyis mtha' skor khrag mtsho'i nang / /gri thogs brgyad dang ro gshen nyi shu gcig /bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po khros pa'i gzugs/ /drag gtum 'bar ba'i 'khor tshogs bstod par bgyi/ /kun kyang pad rāg lhun por tsha zer 'od/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo skad cig nyid la sgrol/ /ma rungs las gshen tshogs rnamsྎ /gzhan yang gnod sbyin dbang po khyod kyi 'khor/

/btsan bdud ma mo the'u rang gshin rje sogs/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /mthu stobs dpag med ldan kun bstod par bgyi/ /yam shud khyod kyis thub pa'i bstan pa srungs/ /de 'dzin dge 'dun sde bcas bu bzhin skyongs/ /'jig rten bde skyid yar ngo'i zla ltar spel/ /bcol ba'i las rnams 'bad med 'grub par mdzod/ /khyad par rdo rje 'chang dngos tshar pa rje'i/ /snyan brgyud bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur spel/ /de la 'khu ba'i dam nyams sdig can tshogs/ /ma thogs ring pa'i tshul gyis myur du sgrol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/ /'di phyi bar do'i grogs por khyod bcol na/ /tshe ring nad med sa lam kun bgrod nas/ /rdor 'dzin go 'phang thob pa'i phrin las mdzod// //ces gnod sbyin dbang po beg rtse can 'khor bcas la bstod pa 'jigs rungs gshin rje'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba 'di yang sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rdo rje 'chang dngos dhīḥkā sha mu tra'i snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che la zhe rus kyi 'dun pa rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas chos skyong yam shud dmar po la bstod pa 'di bzhin brtsams pa dge legs 'phel/ yi ge pa ni rang gi dā ri dra pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis pa shu bhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ skyes bu dbang gi mdog can la bstod pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
